name: Ostinato trance
summary: One pattern that never stops; everything around it slowly changes, so the same notes keep meaning something new.
motif: The ostinato is the motif. Other parts never play it; they comment on it.
surprise: A part that has been playing against the ostinato's rhythm (a cross-rhythm) suddenly locks onto it.
ending: Everything leaves; the ostinato plays alone for its last bars and stops mid-pattern.
